goal:
The /money buyback ledger. Spec: docs/economy/2026-11-02-toilet-round-spec.md §K4 and §F4.

SCOPE
- On /money, show the total NEAR sent to the buyback (near_distributed events), the total mPOO returned (mpoo_revenue_received events), and the NEAR currently waiting on buyback_account. Link to the buyback account on the explorer.
- Same visual system and failure rules as the rest of /money: a read that fails shows as unavailable, never as zero.

ACCEPTANCE
- Unit tests for the event aggregation; no horizontal overflow at 390 px; npm test and npm run build green.

DO NOT
- No contract or keeper changes.
